newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Nov 6.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - Nov 6.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Wednesday:

** The Dow Jones average jumped 39.50 points to 6,081.18 as investors bet President Bill Clinton would be re-elected while Republicans would keep control of Congress, pointing to more modest economic growth and low inflation ahead.
** President Suharto will chair the monthly cabinet meeting and is expected to announce inflation, trade and other macroeconomic data at around midday.
** The Composite Index rose 5.56 points, or 0.96 percent, to close at 583.87 points on Tuesday.
** On Wednesday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,329.5/30.5 at 0115 GMT against Tuesday closing of 2,329.60/2,330.10.
** Salt processor Fiskaragung following its announcement of nine-month profits of 48.74 billion rupiah, against 15.74 billion rupiah in the same period last year.
** Astra International on news that PT Timor Putra Nasional planned to manufacture utility vans with South Korean partner, Kia Motors Corp.
** Indosat, which is scheduled to release its nine-month results this morning.
** Banking stocks on possible spill-over effects of heavy oversubscription of Bank Negara Indonesia (BNI) initial public offering.
** Great River International following an extension to its licensing agreement with Italian fashion house Nino Cerruti.
